market_definition: Acrylic Sealants comprises water-based or other acrylic-polymer sealant products used for filling and sealing joints, cracks and gaps, particularly in building interiors and finishing applications. The market covers sealants sold as formulated products, not acrylic adhesives or paints. By Formulation • Water-Based • Solvent-Based • Elastomeric Acrylic By Grade • Interior • Exterior • Paintable • Low-VOC By Form • Cartridge • Tub • Pail By Application • Window and Door Frames • Wall Cracks • Drywall Joints • Decorative Finishing By End Use • Residential Construction • Commercial Construction • Renovation and Repair • Industrial By Region • North America • Europe • Asia Pacific • Latin America • Middle East • Africa EXCLUDED from the market: Acrylic adhesives, caulks based on other chemistries, paints, coatings, fillers and joint accessories sold separately. COMPANY TYPE IN THIS LIST - DISTRIBUTOR: a distributor, stockist or specialty reseller that buys these products from their makers and sells them to industrial, construction or trade customers. EXCLUDED companies: product and raw-material makers and their own sales subsidiaries; companies selling only the excluded products; service-only firms.
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR DEFINITION (physical goods market): a company whose PRIMARY business is buying in volume from manufacturers and reselling/distributing onward - wholesale, authorized, value-added or stocking distributor. EXCLUDED: channel partners, resellers, VARs, dealers, agents and brokers that do not stock or wholesale; manufacturers and OEMs (including a manufacturer's own sales subsidiary); system integrators; and pure service providers or consultancies. Continent / Geography = countries with a physical site (HQ, office, warehouse, plant). Operational Presence = every country the company does business in, which is WIDER.
